entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Gwalior
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Notice has been served upon the father of the victim.

This is first bail application filed by the applicant under Section 483 of Bhartiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita , 2023 for grant of regular bail relating to FIR/Crime No. 196/2024 registered at Police Station - Dharnawada, District - Guna for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 376 (2) (n) of IPC and Section 5/6 of POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel for the applicant contends that applicant is aged about 19 years and is in custody since 05.12.2024.

It is submitted that allegations levelled by the prosecution is that the father of the prosecutrix approached the police authorities that daughter, the victim who was aged about 14 years disappeared and later on she was recovered.

It is contended by counsel for the applicant that the statement of the victim recorded u/s. 161 and 164 of Cr.P.C. reflects that the victim on her own volition came NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2025:MPHC-GWL:2672 2 MCRC-5880-2025 along with the present applicant and there was inaction on the part of the parents of the victim to approach the authority.
Applicant's past record was unblemished, therefore, applicant deserves to be enlarged on bail.

3. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer on the ground that offence has been Chainsingh Banjara vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 7 February, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/125005162/
1 committed against a minor, therefore, considering the nature of allegation, no case for grant of bail is made out.

entities.text: Chainsingh Banjara vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 4. Considering the submissions advanced on behalf of the parties and that DNA report does not corroborate the prosecution story and the applicant is aged about 19 years and he is in custody since 05.12.2024, the application is allowed.

5. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned their appearance before the said Court on all such dates as may be fixed in this regard during the pendency of trial.
6. It is further directed that the applicants shall comply with the provisions of Section 480 (3) of the BNSS, 2023.
7. Accordingly, this M.Cr.C. stands allowed and disposed of.
